group entry "Entry" {
  node Entry "CanvasPlugin" ref="packages/plugins/plugin-canvas/src/CanvasPlugin.ts"

  node Body "plugin.tsx" ref="packages/plugins/plugin-canvas/src/plugin.tsx"
}
group caps "Capabilities" {
  node Surface "react-surface" ref="packages/plugins/plugin-canvas/src/capabilities/react-surface.tsx"
  node GraphBuilder "app-graph-builder" ref="packages/plugins/plugin-canvas/src/capabilities/app-graph-builder.ts"

  node OpHandler "operation-handler" ref="packages/plugins/plugin-chess/src/capabilities/operation-handler.ts"
}
group code "Code" {
  node Ops "Operations" ref="packages/plugins/plugin-chess/src/operations"
  node Containers "Containers" ref="packages/plugins/plugin-canvas/src/containers"
  node Model "Model" ref="packages/plugins/plugin-canvas/src/model"
  node Types "Types/Schema" ref="packages/plugins/plugin-canvas/src/types"
  node UiPkg "react-ui-canvas" ref="packages/ui/react-ui-canvas"
}
edge Entry -> Meta
edge Entry composes Body "lazy import"
edge Body composes Surface
edge Body composes GraphBuilder
edge Body composes Settings
edge Body composes OpHandler
edge OpHandler -> Ops
edge Surface -> Containers "renders"
edge Containers -> UiPkg
edge Containers -> Model
edge GraphBuilder -> Types
edge Settings -> Types
